title: Fenwick Tree: Prefix Sums with Updates
contract: Operations [0,index,delta] add delta; [1,index,0] query inclusive prefix sum. Array is nonempty.
brute: long[] values=new long[a.length];for(int i=0;i<a.length;i++)values[i]=a[i];List<Long> out=new ArrayList<>();for(int[] op:ops){if(op[0]==0)values[op[1]]+=op[2];else{long sum=0;for(int i=0;i<=op[1];i++)sum+=values[i];out.add(sum);}emit("Scan the requested prefix","values",values,"answers",out);}return out;
optimal: long[] bit=new long[a.length+1];for(int i=0;i<a.length;i++)for(int j=i+1;j<bit.length;j+=j&-j)bit[j]+=a[i];List<Long> out=new ArrayList<>();for(int[] op:ops){if(op[0]==0){for(int j=op[1]+1;j<bit.length;j+=j&-j)bit[j]+=op[2];}else{long sum=0;for(int j=op[1]+1;j>0;j-=j&-j)sum+=bit[j];out.add(sum);}emit("Jump by the lowest set bit","operation",op,"fenwick cells",bit,"answers",out);}return out;
reasoning: A plain array needs a scan to answer each prefix query.
In one-based indexing, bit[i] summarizes the final lowbit(i) elements of its prefix.
Queries subtract lowbit to visit disjoint blocks; updates add lowbit to visit every containing block. Convert external zero-based indices exactly once. Assignment requires computing a delta first.
complexity: O((n+q) log n), O(n) in this build variant
